text_block_list.text: The day of the Fan Fest has arrived, and Mihono Bourbon is participating in a certain contest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will be in the Poker Face Championship.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It's a competition to see how well entrants can keep a straight face while experiencing "fear" or "shock."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I was selected to represent my class in the competition.
She has a poker face by default. On the outside, she's expressionless to the point that people think she's a robot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All students from the winning class will receive a ticket for a free carrot parfait.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Eating parfaits with my classmates will help to deepen my bonds with them… I cannot fail.
She looks even more serious than usual.
All the contestants from the academy gather and the competition begins.

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Who will take home victory?! Let's find out!

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Round one is the haunted house! If you can make it through while maintaining your poker face, you pass!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All light sources are blocked off. Visibility is poor. Caution required.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sensors indicate staff approaching from straight ahead. I have to greet them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Ghost Costume
text_block_list.text: Oooooh… I will haaave my reveeenge…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please watch your step as you do.
Round one seems pretty difficult for the average contestant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No way! I can't do this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How many times did I tell you that?!

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Must be seriously spooky inside because our contestants are dropping out one after another! Fewer than half remain!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ummm, did I make it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Let's keep it moving! Next up is…

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Round two—super-spicy ramen! If you can eat the whole bowl while keeping a straight face, you pass!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Detecting high levels of spice in system.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I need… water…
A lot of people drop out in this round too.

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: What a shocker, folks! As we move into the final round, all we have left are…

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Two contestants!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Victory is within sight.

text_block_list.name: Expressionless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Now then, time for round three, in which our contestants will confess their feelings to someone important to them!

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: If they can confess while maintaining their poker face, then they pass! You're up, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Someone special… In other words you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well… You're always devoted to helping me train at my best.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You wake up early, retire late, and do everything in your power to help us win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel very supported because of your dependability and warmth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is quite difficult to express with words, but I am very gratef—
Suddenly, a gust of wind kicks up some dust.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon has been eliminateeeeed!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Our parfaits!
Bourbon wasn't able to win the competition, but it was still a rather heartwarming experience.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well… You're always devoted to helping me train at my best.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You wake up early, retire late, and do everything in your power to help us win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I feel very supported because of your dependability and warmth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It is quite difficult to express with words, but I am very grateful for you, Master. Thank you.
Mihono Bourbon is, without a doubt, incredibly important to me. I feel like I can achieve anything with her by my side.
I forget all about the contest happening around us and express my gratitude to her as best I can.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master…

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Wait, look at Mihono Bourbon's tail! It's swishing enthusiastically!

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: She can't hide her joy! Does this count as grounds for elimination? What will the judges say?

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: Nope, she's safe! Her face is still totally blank!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I did it.
The other contestant gets visibly embarrassed while expressing her gratitude to her master.

text_block_list.name: Championship Organizer
text_block_list.text: The winner is Mihono Bourbooooon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, I won!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Now, all of my classmates and I can enjoy carrot parfaits together.
I can't help but smile at seeing Mihono Bourbon this uncharacteristically happy.
